text:
Cami (partnerships): Quick sync - we need a short checklist for orchestration gateway adapters before partner outreach. Who owns what and target dates?

Jordan (product): Draft timeline: adapter API + stable docs by 2026-04-10, internal canary by 2026-04-15, partner trials start 2026-04-22, cloud marketplace submission week of 2026-04-29. Thoughts on feasibility?

Micah (eng): 04-10 is doable if we scope to the minimal adapter surface. Need to finalize the API contract today. Proposal for minimal endpoint below.

```
// adapter interface
POST /v1/gateway/adapt
{
  \"model\": \"redwood/llm-quant\",
  \"max_tokens\": 512,
  \"routing\": \"latency-opt\"
}
```

Micah (eng): Also flag: we should include a migration note for customers on the old gateway plugin. Sabrina - can you take docs + examples?

Sabrina (devrel): I can own docs and example repos. Plan: small examples for LangFlow, a basic Airflow operator, and a plain orchestration YAML snippet. ETA for first draft 2026-04-08.

Cami (partnerships): Jordan, can you own marketplace packaging and partner legal checklist (SKU, billing model, terms)? We need those before submission.

Jordan (product): Yep. Preference: usage-based billing for Hosted with commit tiers for Dedicated. I'll sync with finance and drop a draft package by 2026-04-12.

Micah (eng): Heads-up from hardware partner: Ampere vendor says their optimized quant driver is behind a release. I opened vendor ticket. If they can't deliver by 2026-04-18, fallback plan is to run adapters on x86 GPU pools for partner trials.

Cami (partnerships): I'll escalate with vendor-rel. Also—do we want an NDA/embargo for the SI joint announcement? We should coordinate timing with partner trials.

Sabrina (devrel): Recommend embargo until partner trials finish (target 2026-04-22). I'll draft a two-paragraph joint blurb and a short one-pager for partners to review.

Micah (eng): Canary test plan: run 1k concurrent short requests and 200 long-sequence requests. I'll add a tiny canary script to infra:

```
./scripts/canary-run --short 1000 --long 200 --model redwood/llm-quant
```

Micah (eng): Will tag telemetry as partnership=si-gateway, phase=canary. Pushing artifacts after CI.

deploy-bot: CI pipeline passed for feature/gateway-adapter — build 20260402. Artifacts: https://ci.internal/repo/artifacts/20260402

Cami (partnerships): Once Sabrina publishes docs, please post the URL here so we can include it in the partner onboarding packet. Also need a short install snippet for the marketplace listing.

Sabrina (devrel): Will publish and share link. Example gateway-config for docs: 

```
adapter:
  name: redwood-gateway
  endpoint: https://gateway.redwood.ai/adapt
  auth: bearer <token>
```

Jordan (product): I'll prepare marketplace screenshots, security checklist (KMS, audit logs, VPC support), and the legal checklist by 2026-04-09.

Cami (partnerships): Owners recap:
- Adapter API + canary: Micah
- Docs + samples: Sabrina
- Marketplace + billing/legal: Jordan
- Vendor escalation + partner comms: Cami

Cami (partnerships): If no objections I'll lock dates and start partner comms tomorrow. Scheduling a 15-min sync on 2026-04-06 to surface blockers. /remind me to ping vendor-rel 10:00 PST tomorrow :)

Micah (eng): :+1: from eng.

Sabrina (devrel): :+1: will share draft docs link when ready.

Jordan (product): :+1: will get finance sign-off on SKU and commit tiers.

Cami (partnerships): Thanks team — Ill send the partner packet draft after the 04-06 sync.
